Leave granted.
2.
The appellant has approached this Court aggrieved
by the judgment(s) and order(s) of the High Court of
Delhi at New Delhi dated 20.03.2013 passed in W.P.(C)
No.8432/2011  and  dated  27.11.2015  passed  in  Review
Petition No.245/2013.
3.
While  these  appeals  were  pending  before  this
Court, it is seen that the parties have arrived  at a
settlement.  The said Deed of Settlement has already
been  filed  before  this  Court  and  the  same  is  on
record.   The  terms  of  the  said  Deed  of  Settlement
shall form part of this judgment.
4.
Accordingly,  these  appeals  are  disposed  of  in
terms  of  the  Deed  of  Settlement  with  a  further
